Imani: science and illustration · expanded view

Imani enjoys pond observations and explaining the findings through drawings, diagrams and short stories. A science fair felt best when visitors understood the poster. Patient care does not attract Imani, and neither science nor creative work should erase the other interest. Imani is willing to compare degrees and keeps future spending moderate.

Narrative model, with its answers frozen before the first run. Optional questions omitted by the shorter route are marked. These are synthetic checks, not observations of students.

Authored model & first-run review

Collected observations with a club and revised explanatory sketches. Has not worked in a research lab or design studio.

Parallel interests are intentional; no single professional identity or aptitude is inferred.

Choice screens: 94 including lifestyle and profession questions; introductory screens are not counted.

Low experience does not change interests or career rankings · A more expensive lifestyle changes money needs, not interest matching · Answers and recommendations survive save/reload · Open profiles do not force three pathways or a profession · Optional detail preserves all six official interest scores · Plan creation preserves earlier completed work, notes and official answers
